name: VITEM IV Student visa

requirement_groups.name: Admitted to a recognised Brazilian institution

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an official letter of acceptance from a Brazilian educational institution recognised by the Ministry of Education, for a course of regular study, research, or extension activities.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission from a recognised Brazilian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of financial means to support the stay -- personal funds, a scholarship, or a sponsor's declaration -- plus valid health insurance covering the stay.
requirements.fix_path: Provide bank statements, a scholarship award letter, or a sponsor's financial declaration.

evidence_required.document: Official letter of acceptance from the Brazilian institution
Proof of funds or scholarship, and health insurance
Federal Police (Polícia Federal) registration within 90 days of arrival, for the CRNM

outcome.duration_length: tied to course length, renewed via the CRNM

sources.title: Polícia Federal (gov.br/pf) -- Autorização de Residência, the federal police portal listing residence-authorisation categories including student status

notes: Postgraduate researchers and exchange students may hold internship or fellowship contracts that permit a stipend without this constituting 'work' in the Lei 13.445/2017 sense -- this nuance was not independently confirmed in full detail against a primary source in this research pass and is flagged rather than asserted as a blanket work-rights exception. Unlike Korea's F-2-7 or Poland's student route, no dedicated post-graduation job-seeker status was identified for Brazil in sources checked for this build -- the standard path from student to work status is a direct conversion to br_work_visa upon securing employer sponsorship, without an intermediate job-search-specific permit.
